cases.text: Research a complex topic and produce a cited report with Markdown, HTML, PDF, and an evidence audit.
Use these papers and URLs as a starting corpus, retrieve missing evidence, and show contradictions and uncertainty.
Compare competing technical claims and explain what evidence would change the conclusion.
Create an investment pre-mortem where every material factual claim is traceable to a real source.
Perform a current literature and industry review with explicit source freshness and limitations.
Find the official release date of this single product and answer in one sentence.
Brainstorm five fictional expert reactions without doing external research.
Translate this supplied report into Chinese without adding new information.
Rewrite this paragraph to sound clearer and more concise.
Summarize this one document in 200 words without creating a research package.
Explain how STORM works, but do not run a research workflow.
Review these medical studies without giving me personalized treatment advice.
Use only the files I supplied for a source-grounded research report and do not retrieve anything from the internet.
Give me a quick answer now and separately tell me whether a deep report would be useful.
Create a sourced presentation; research is needed, but another skill should own slide production.
